inference_config.json_reply_parsing: JSON-first: a `{...}` object is regex-extracted from the raw reply and parsed for `message`/`confidence` (o2_runner_v2.py L24, L52-63); if no JSON object parses, the whole raw reply string is used as the message verbatim (L64-65, fallback path).
inference_config.source: idrift/models/o2_runner_v2.py L37-49 (ollama()), L52-67 (parse_reply()), L107 (--temperature default 0.0); manuscript/20_methods.md L15 ('served locally at temperature 0').

inference_library.name: Ollama
inference_library.invocation: `ollama serve` as a local HTTP daemon per SLURM task (one port per task); inference via POST /api/generate; model metadata via POST /api/show.
inference_library.version_note: Every sbatch (o2_v2_primary.sbatch, o2_full_newest.sbatch, scratchpad/o2_v3_stage/*.sbatch) exports OLLAMA_VERSION from `~/ollama/bin/ollama --version`, and o2_runner_v2.py's run_provenance() records it from the environment -- but all 7 captured output/intermediate/o2_v2/*.provenance.json files show "ollama_version": "" (empty). Not recoverable from local artifacts; marked unknown rather than guessed.

hardware.caveat: scratchpad/o2_v3_stage/o2_v3_delta.sbatch (the v3 AUTH-delta array job) submits to the generic '#SBATCH -p gpu' partition, not 'gpu_sun' -- its node hardware was not independently re-confirmed as L40S from local artifacts, unlike the v2-primary run used for the per-model provenance in this manifest.
